name: Sea Chest
subtitle: Milestone escrow
description: Example 9 — buyer escrows native coin, approves milestones to release seller funds, refunds the rest anytime. Approvals are irreversible; exits cost 5 state units.
long_description: Two-sided escrow for milestone work. The buyer deposits once at deal creation; each approveMilestone moves the specified amount into the seller's withdrawable balance. Unapproved remainder is refundable by the buyer at any moment — even under the emergency brake, since refunds and withdrawals are exits. Milestone amounts are specified at approval time instead of a stored array: the chain proves how much was released, the off-chain agreement holds the schedule. Irreversible approvals are what make the accounting race-free.

interface.description: Returns the constant marker value that identifies personal-test mode in the deploy policy.
Lets the deal's buyer approve a milestone index for an amount of the deposit, making it withdrawable by the seller; irreversible and no funds move yet.
Returns the guardian address that may engage the brake.
Returns the URI and document hash that describe the brake policy.
Returns the current brake level, the guardian address and the timestamp when the brake last changed.
Returns the unapproved part of the deposit to the deal's buyer in native coin; only the buyer may call it.
Lets a registered token report a receipt so the personal-test token cap is checked; only callable by the token itself in personal-test mode.
Opens a deal with the seller and a fixed milestone count and holds the native coin sent with the call as the deposit; needs open brake.
Returns the deal's buyer, seller, refundable amount and seller-withdrawable amount.
Returns the raw deal record: buyer, seller, deposited, approved total, withdrawn total and milestone count.
Raises the brake to a stronger level (1 or 2) to block new entries; only the guardian may call it and it cannot be lowered.
Returns the text 'personal-test' if this instance was deployed under a personal-test policy, otherwise 'testnet'.
Returns whether the milestone identified by the key hash has been approved.
Returns the id that the next created deal will receive.
Returns whether the given account is on the personal-test allow list for this instance.
Returns the policy authority address used to recognize allowed sibling instances, or zero outside personal-test mode.
Returns true if this instance was deployed in personal-test mode with access and value caps.
Returns the maximum native coin balance this instance may hold in personal-test mode, or 0 if disabled.
Returns the owner address of the personal-test policy, or zero if personal-test mode is off.
Returns the personal-test policy tuple: marker, owner address, native cap and token cap.
Returns the maximum token amount this instance may hold in personal-test mode, or 0 if disabled.
Pays the seller the approved amount not yet withdrawn in native coin; only the deal's seller may call it.
Adds or removes an account on the personal-test allow list; only the personal-test owner may call it and the owner cannot be removed.
